descriptors.mapping_note: 测的是电解液 E1–E4 本身
descriptors.scale: Li2S8 最大溶解量（电解液中）

C1.desc: 扣式全电池（薄锂、高载量）
C1.NP_author_basis: 理论容量（作者：43% excess in theory）
C1.quote: assembled with ultrathin Li anodes of 50 μm (15.0 mm in diameter, 43% excess in theory), high-S-loading cathodes of 4.3 mg cm−2, PP separators (19.0 mm in diameter), and 35 µL electrolyte (electrolyte to S (E/S) ratio of 6.1 μL mg−1) … The S cathodes were punched into disks with a diameter of 13.0 mm … at 0.1 C (1 C = 1672 mA g−1)

C2.desc: 扣式全电池（不加 LiNO3，测负极动力学）
C2.quote: cells were assembled with 600 µm Li anodes (16.0 mm in diameter), 1.3 mg cm−2 S cathodes, PP separators (19.0 mm in diameter), and 25 µL electrolyte without LiNO3 … at room temperature

C3.NP_author_basis: 理论容量（作者：25% excess in theory）
C3.quote: S cathodes with a single-side areal S loading of 7.4 mg cm−2 were cut into a size of 4 × 7 cm2 … The thickness of Li metal anodes was 75 µm on a single side and 4 × 7 cm2 in size (25% excess in theory) … A low E/S ratio of 3.5 g gS−1 was employed. The pouch cells were tested at 0.05 C (1 C = 1000 mA g−1)

C4.desc: Li|Li2S8 溶液正极电池（碳纸，测正极动力学）
C4.rate_note: 恒电位 2.05 V 成核测试
C4.quote: Li | Li2S8 cells were assembled with 600 µm Li anodes (16.0 mm in diameter), carbon paper (CP) cathodes (13.0 mm in diameter), PP separators (19.0 mm in diameter), and 25 µL electrolyte with 1.0 M[S] Li2S8
